data.name: Narendrasinh
data.gender_notes: Narendrasinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Narendra means 'Lord of men'. Sinh means 'lion'. Thus, Narendrasinh can be interpreted as 'Lord of lions' or 'Lion of the Lord'. This name is derived from the popular Hindu god Shiva, who is often depicted as a lion-headed deity. The name Narendrasinh carries the meaning “Lord of men” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Narendrasinh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of men and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Narendrasinh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of men.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narendrasinh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Narendrasinh is rooted in Indian mythology and carries a rich cultural legacy. When used as a title or name, it evokes a sense of power, courage, and ruler-ship, reflecting the powerful images of Hindu gods such as Shiva and Rama. It is a name that resonates with both the past and the present, reminding us of the strength and values that have defined Indian culture for centuries.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the lion is a symbol of strength, power, and fearlessness. Narendrasinh thus embodies these qualities, inspiring those who bear the name to emulate them in their own lives. The name is also associated with Lord Shiva, who represents transformation, destruction, and creation. Narendrasinh therefore serves as a reminder of the divine presence within us and the potential for infinite growth and transformation that lies within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Narendrasinh: Radiant (Narendra) Lord Hari (Hari is another name for Vishnu) within (Singh) the self. Embodiment of inner strength and devotion to Hari.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Narendrasinh was a Jain Tirthankara born during the 22nd Arhat Calendar cycle. The name Narendrasinh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Narendrasinh has gained popularity due to the Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. However, it is important to note that this modern usage is unrelated to the historical reference of Narendrasinh as a Jain Tirthankara.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Aditya Narendrasinh in Kathmandu, Nepal attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Narendrasinh, which means "Lord of men". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
